## What kind of change is this?

- [ ] New catalog entry
- [ ] Fix a broken/outdated entry
- [ ] Other (README, CONTRIBUTING, infra, etc.)

## Checklist (for new entries)

- [ ] The linked repo resolves and is not empty or archived.
- [ ] It is genuinely about Praxist plugins.
- [ ] It is not already listed anywhere in this README.
- [ ] The entry leads with a bold action phrase, then the name and author links, then one factual
      line. See CONTRIBUTING.md for the exact shape.
- [ ] It is in the right category.
